title: The Seasons and Their Own Time-Forms

sections.title: Not the case you'd expect
sections.content: Each season has a fixed, slightly irregular way of saying "in [season]" — you can't just add -ban/-ben the way you might expect. tavasszal ("in spring") uses -val/-vel, assimilated onto tavasz. nyáron ("in summer") and télen ("in winter") use -on/-en. ősszel ("in autumn") uses -vel again. Learn each one as its own fixed chunk.

items.spanish: Ilyenkor, ősszel, gyakran felhős az idő.
items.english: At this time of year, in autumn, the weather is often cloudy.

sections.content: évszak means "season" itself — Melyik a kedvenc évszakod? ("Which is your favourite season?") uses évszak plus the possessive -d you already know.
